links.outcome: Alignment of generated answers with authoritative knowledge, retrieval-augmented agent versus ChatGPT
links.effect: RDguru outperformed ChatGPT in generating descriptions aligned with authoritative knowledge, measured by ROUGE scores, GPT-4-based automatic rating, and RAGAs metrics.
links.quote: A multi-aspect Q&A analysis demonstrates RDguru outperforms ChatGPT in generating descriptions aligned with authoritative knowledge, quantified by ROUGE scores, GPT-4-based automatic rating, and RAGAs evaluation metrics.

unlisted_practices: Multi-source fusion diagnostic model (deep Q-network) combining GPT-4, PheLR and phenotype matching to improve diagnostic recall
Multi-round phenotype-oriented questioning during consultation to refine differential diagnosis

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates RDguru, an agentic LLM system for rare disease diagnosis and Q&A, using retrospective published cases and benchmarks without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
